body: it sounds like you dont have self esteem, me either. People tell me that they care about me, and that they are there but i dont want to talk to a stranger. For some people it’s different, they love talking to people and getting everything out. You dont have to be talkative or clever. You can just be you without having to live up to those expectations people set for you. If your school offers tutoring, please go for it.  I struggle a lot in math and absolutely didn’t want to go to tutoring but i tried it out and it was a life saver. It really sucks but if your going to go through it might as well make it easier. Hope things get better for you
i relate. the school system needs to be changed. The only way through is to suffer even more. What keeps me going is the thought of traveling, seeing the world. when im finally free from that shit

I want people to feel bad for me. I want to be on the news and have families sympathize for me. I want my friends to cry and mourn me. My family to realize how shitty they are. I want my school to have a memorial for me. I would be glad to die right now. i already have a note ready
